comment_regular: Verified debug-render root setter. Updates g_PathGridDebugRenderingEnabled. Enabling creates a shared NiNode, attaches DebugRender_GetOrCreateVertexColorProperty, and adds the root to TES/ObjectLODRoot; disabling removes the root, clears its child objects, releases it, and nulls g_PathGridDebugRenderRoot. Called by TESPathGrid_ToggleDebugRendering before per-cell render rebuild/clear.
